title: Prescribed Flow and the Medicaid Monthly Rate for Home Oxygen Therapy — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
**Clause.** For an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility crossover, the flow multiplier of the Medicaid monthly rate follows the prescribed flow on the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record:

- a prescribed flow above the system class's high-flow threshold raises the stationary fee by the class's high-flow uplift percentage;
- a prescribed flow below the class's low-flow threshold lowers it by the class's low-flow reduction percentage;
- any other flow leaves the stationary fee as it is.

In every Home Oxygen Therapy class the high-flow threshold is 4 liters per minute with an uplift of 50 percent, and the low-flow threshold is 1 liter per minute with a reduction of 50 percent.

| Prescribed flow (liters per minute) | Stationary fee |
|---|---|
| above 4 | raised by 50 percent — multiplied by 1.5 |
| 1 up to 4, both included | as it is |
| below 1 | lowered by 50 percent — multiplied by 0.5 |

**Edges (hypothetical stationary fee 172.61).** Flow 4: 172.61. Flow 4.5: 258.915. Flow 1: 172.61. Flow 0.5: 86.305.
